v1.feedback: The single closed-loop differential growth reads as a ribbed tube rather than a branching vascular vessel — split the ring into multiple interleaving strands or add secondary growth fronts so the silhouette has enough anatomical complexity for the bonk to deform against. The color blush is too subtle at current lerp factors (absBk peaks briefly near 0.55 then decays fast) — push the flush harder toward saturated coral or momentary white-hot at impact so the hit reads instantly. BONK_DECAY at 3.2 kills the deformation in under half a second; halve the decay rate or layer a slower secondary wobble so the form visibly jiggles for 1–2s and the comic timing actually lands.

v2.feedback: The squash-stretch bonk reads clearly as a comedic scale swerve on a genuinely grown biomorphic tower — the linked idea lands. To push it further: make the bonk structurally asymmetric so individual strands buckle or splay differently rather than applying a uniform Y-scale; the current sinusoidal wobble recovery feels too mechanical for organic tissue — consider per-strand phase offsets or damped jitter. The pre-grown tower fills the frame well and the warm palette is restrained, but the bonk color flash (orange→white) could hold a beat longer at peak to let the comedy register before decaying.
